Il codice di condotta di EVIL, le leggi: EVIL’s code of conduct, the Italian and European laws that matter for cybersecurity learners, and how to report a vulnerability responsibly.
La conoscenza è neutra, come il fuoco: p: Knowledge is neutral, like fire: it can cook or destroy. EVIL teaches how attacks work so that you learn to prevent them, not to commit them. The same skill becomes a crime if used without permission. This page explains the rules of the game: what you may do, what the law says and how to report a problem properly.

Le tecniche che impari su EVIL — SQL inj: The techniques you learn on EVIL — SQL injection, scanning, OSINT, malware analysis — are the same ones used by both attackers and defenders. What changes is not the technique, but the purpose and the permission. Studying how to get into a system is how you learn to close its doors: it is the job of security work.
L'obiettivo di EVIL è formare persone ca: EVIL’s goal is to train people who can reach the highest technical level together with the highest sense of responsibility: programmers, security professionals, ethical hackers, security researchers, software engineers. Competence and legality always go together.
Chi usa EVIL si impegna a:: Those who use EVIL commit to:
usare gli strumenti di analisi <strong>s: using the analysis tools only on their own systems or ones they have written authorisation for;
non danneggiare, interrompere o sovracca: not damaging, disrupting or overloading third parties’ systems and services;
non raccogliere né diffondere dati perso: not collecting or spreading other people’s personal data without a legal basis (no doxxing);
non usare quanto imparato per frode, est: not using what they learn for fraud, extortion, stalking, defamation or any other offence;
trattare i dati simulati o di esempio co: treating simulated or sample data as such, without passing it off as real evidence;
segnalare in modo responsabile le vulner: reporting the vulnerabilities they find responsibly, without exploiting them.
Alla registrazione accetti questo codice: When you sign up you accept this code and the privacy notice. Breaking it leads to your account being suspended and, depending on the case, legal consequences for which you are personally responsible.
Prima di analizzare un sistema che non è: Before analysing a system that is not yours, you need written permission from whoever is entitled to give it, with clear rules of engagement. A verbal agreement is not enough. The document should state at least:
<strong>perimetro</strong>: quali domini: scope: which domains, IP addresses and applications are included, and what is excluded;
<strong>tempi</strong>: le finestre in c: timing: the windows in which you may operate and the emergency contacts;
<strong>tecniche</strong>: cosa è permes: techniques: what is allowed and what is not (for example denial of service or social engineering against employees);
<strong>dati</strong>: come trattare eve: data: how to handle any sensitive data found, how long to keep it and how to destroy it.
Regola pratica: se non puoi mostrare un: Rule of thumb: if you cannot show an authorisation document, do not run the test. EVIL teaches the method; responsibility for carrying it out on real systems remains with you and the client.
In Italia l'accesso e il danneggiamento: In Italy, unauthorised access to and damage of computer systems are criminal offences. The main articles of the Criminal Code on the subject are:
Accesso abusivo a un sistema informatico: Unauthorised access to a computer or telecommunications system, or remaining there against the will of whoever has the right to exclude.
Detenzione, diffusione e installazione a: Unlawfully holding, spreading and installing access codes (passwords, credentials) to protected systems.
Intercettazione, impedimento o interruzi: Unlawful interception, prevention or interruption of computer or telecommunications communications.
Danneggiamento di informazioni, dati, pr: Damaging information, data, programs and computer systems, whether public or private.
Frode informatica: alterare un sistema o: Computer fraud: altering a system or data to gain an unjust profit at someone else’s expense.
A livello europeo e nazionale contano an: At European and national level the GDPR (EU Regulation 2016/679) also matters for personal data, as does the NIS2 directive, transposed in Italy in 2024, for the security of many organisations’ networks and information systems.
Questa pagina è una sintesi didattica e: This page is an educational summary and is not legal advice. Legal references can change: for a specific case, check the text in force and, if needed, consult a professional.
Anche le informazioni pubbliche su una p: Public information about a person is personal data too. Collecting and cross-referencing it (for example with OSINT) requires a legal basis (Art. 6 GDPR) and, if you reuse that data outside personal study, the duty to inform the person (Art. 14). Doxxing — collecting and spreading someone’s data to expose, intimidate or harass them — is forbidden on EVIL and may be a criminal offence.
Per questo i moduli OSINT di EVIL sono o: That is why EVIL’s OSINT modules are oriented towards assessing your own exposure and public figures, not profiling private individuals.
Se durante uno studio autorizzato scopri: If, during authorised study, you find a vulnerability, the right thing is to report it to whoever runs the system and give them time to fix it before making it public. In practice:
cerca un canale ufficiale: un file <code: look for an official channel: a /.well-known/security.txt file, a "security" page or a bug bounty programme;
descrivi il problema in modo chiaro e ri: describe the problem clearly and reproducibly, without exploiting it beyond what is needed to demonstrate it;
concorda tempi ragionevoli per la correz: agree reasonable timescales for the fix and do not disclose the details until it is resolved;
non chiedere denaro in cambio del silenz: do not ask for money in exchange for silence: that would be extortion.
In Italia il punto di riferimento nazion: In Italy the national point of reference for incidents is CSIRT Italia (the National Cybersecurity Agency). Found a problem on EVIL itself? Write to us from the Help page.
Alcune situazioni sembrano innocue ma no: Some situations look harmless but are not:
una scansione \"solo passiva\" di un sit: a "passive-only" scan of someone else’s site may still breach its terms of service;
leggere dati pubblici su una persona è l: reading public data about a person is lawful; collecting and profiling it systematically often is not;
provare \"giusto una volta\" una credenz: trying a found credential "just once" is already unauthorised access;
un sistema \"sembra abbandonato\" non si: a system that "looks abandoned" does not mean it has no owner.
Nel dubbio, fermati e chiedi. Esercitati: When in doubt, stop and ask. Practise on your own systems, on EVIL’s Virtual lab or on environments built for practice. Uncertainty is not authorisation.
